job: Read what an object is as labelled values in a grid.
purpose: A grid of key and value pairs for detail panels: what a request was, who owns a key, when a run started. Columns step down by themselves as the panel narrows. A value can carry a copy button with data-copy. data-layout="split" makes label-left, value-right rows for a narrow panel.
useWhen: A detail panel, sheet or card shows the facts of one record.
Values such as IDs and URLs should be copyable.

avoidWhen.when: Many records with the same fields.

states.name: copied
states.how: data-copied on a value for a moment after its copy button is pressed

variants.useWhen: A single column in a narrow panel.
Two columns in a medium panel.
Three columns in a wide detail view.
Label left, value right, as in a billing summary.
Hairlines between rows of a split list.
A value with a copy button; the attribute can hold the text to copy.
The value is an ID, a path or a hash.
The value is a sentence, not an identifier.
Keys in normal text instead of mono capitals.

parts.role: The text inside a value with a copy button.

keyboard.does: On a copy button, copies the value.
